transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad to meet you today. What brings you in to see me?
I've been feeling really down and empty for months, but lately it has gotten much worse. I've started hearing and seeing things that other people can't, and it's really scaring me.
Do you only hear or see these things when you are feeling very down, or do they also happen during times when your mood is completely normal?

They actually happen even when my mood is completely normal. There have been periods, for at least a couple of weeks, where I felt totally fine emotionally but I was still hearing and seeing those things. It doesn't just happen when I'm feeling down.
Looking back over the entire time you've been dealing with these experiences, would you say you have felt depressed for most of that time, or has the depression only been a small part of it?

I've definitely felt depressed for the majority of the time, probably for more than two years now. It's not just a small part of it; the depression has been a constant, heavy presence hanging over me almost the entire time.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports experiencing auditory and visual hallucinations for at least two weeks in the absence of a major mood episode, which rules out Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features. Additionally, the patient reports that depressive symptoms have been present for the majority of the total duration of the illness (over two years), which fulfills the criteria for Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) and rules out Schizophrenia (where mood symptoms must be brief relative to the total duration of the illness). Thus, the diagnosis is finalized as Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type).
